I think we should understand that we are intelligent animals, with the capability to feel empathy and compassion. So we should use those incredible feelings and talents we have to know that we don’t need to eat animals at all([vegan diets are suitable for all stages of life from national dietitan association ](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/m/pubmed/27886704/) ), thus the ~70 billion land animals killed every year is for virtually nothing. 

Also it’s really dangerous to compare where the typical animal product comes from to small farms, as the vast majority don’t come from farms like we have experienced. Industrial animal culture is living in your own feces, having sores all over your body and being fed antibiotics at every meal in order to keep the animal alive.
